name: Fetish: Wanted
source:
Fetish: Wanted is Fetish's spin-off game and can be played without having seen the previous games.

Set in a high school alternate universe, Hexia received a letter from Vier's high school principal, requesting her to interview some students for a reason unstated. Bored as she always is, she accepted the request without hesitation and her poor butler, Cain, got dragged along.

[From [url=http://ppppantsu.blogspot.com/p/fetish-wanted.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
《Fetish: Wanted》是《Fetish》的外传，无需游玩前作即可体验。

舞台是高中平行世界。赫希娅收到Vier高中校长的来信，被要求采访几名学生，理由不明。像往常一样无聊的她毫不犹豫地答应了，可怜的管家凯恩也被拉了过来。

[译自[url=http://ppppantsu.blogspot.com/p/fetish-wanted.html]官方网站[/url]]
